Identification_Area.title: DSN Archival Tracking Data File Interface

Citation_Information.description: This document specifies content and format of radio metric data from the Deep Space Network (DSN) and the Network Operations Control Center (NOCC) Navigation Subsystem (NAV). The initial release date was 1986-01-01. The document was re-issued on 1988-10-15 with a refined parameter description for Item 112 on page 11. This version was re-issued on 1996-07-31 after reformatting.

Modification_Detail.description: Initial version; scanned from a paper copy, then converted to PDF/A-1b using Adobe Acrobat Reader DC. The initial release date was 1986-01-01; it was re-issued 1988-10-15 with a refined parameter description for Item 112 on page 11. This version was reformatted before being released on 1996-10-15. Added to the PDS Radio Science Documentation bundle in 2020.
